title: F# PureFile
description: Authoritative pure-method whitelist document (.pure.json). Single source of truth for the wire format consumed by fspure-collector and FSharp.PureAnalyzer.

schemaVersion.description: Document schema version. Loaders must reject unknown or newer versions.

packageId.description: Logical package or assembly identity this whitelist describes.

packageVersion.description: Version string of the package or assembly identity.

generatedAt.description: UTC timestamp when the document was produced (ISO-8601 / round-trip).

generator.description: Tool identity that produced the document (name/version).

fullName.description: Fully-qualified method name (IL-style when produced by the collector).

comment.description: Optional note when origin is manual.
